title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line extends vertically from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0893). The third line runs horizontally from (0.75, 0.0893) back to (0.0, 0.0893). Finally, the fourth line completes the rectangle by returning to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translating it with the vector (0.0, 0.0, 0.0). Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0227 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The resulting shape is a cylinder with a rectangular top, characterized by a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.0893 units, and a height of 0.0227 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0893) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0893) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular prism
r = r.extrude(0.0227)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
